decision.explanation: Document D1 provides consistent, corroborated evidence (marriage records, expert testimony, museum records) stating Marion Jessie Thompson was married to Dows Dunham. Document D2 presents a contradictory claim regarding 'Ruby Frewen' but explicitly describes the union as 'impossible' because Frewen died in 1866 while Thompson was born in 1890, framing the claim as a 'shocking discovery' that defies logic and time. Given the instruction to treat fallible data as such and avoid equating competing assertions with different valid entities when one is logically impossible, 'Ruby Frewen' is rejected as an invalid answer based on the internal contradiction within D2 itself (death before birth). Only 'Dows Dunham' represents a supported, logical referent.
